Forms of office and work
The office's form and thus its room Access
layout are part of a system influe- Building services
nced by activity, procedural organ- Construction
isation, IT technology and company DIN 4543-1
culture. The building structure and
design of rooms can have a significant influence on the use. Efficiency
gains can result from factors like
reduction of the area per workstation, rooms designed to support
procedures and improve motivation,
for which emotional factors above all
are decisive, like material and colour
ideas, but also the provision of quiet
and communication areas for formal
and informal meetings. The analysis
of requirements can produce valuable pointers to possible forms of
office.
